item.title: [ALC Beijing][Meetup] Co-meetup of Apache DolphinScheduler and Apache Doris
item.description:
we will hold co-meetup between DolphinScheduler(incubator) and Doris(incubator) community. and the agenda as follows

date: 2020-07-25 14:00
agenda:

14:00 - 14:40 Introduction of Doris core features - pre-aggregation engine and materialized view
《Doris核心功能介绍–预聚合引擎和物化视图》 缪翎，百度研发工程师，Doris PPMC

14:40 - 15:10 Distributed task management platform, making job submit easier
《分布式作业管理平台，让作业提交变得更简单》 李杰，奇安信大数据研发工程师，主要参与DolphinScheduler和Flink的开发与维护

15:10 - 15:50 Doris global dictionary design and implementation based on hive table
《Doris基于hive表的全局字典设计与实现 》 王博，美团点评数据开发工程师，主要参与Doris和Kylin的开发与维护

15:50 - 16:30 DolphinScheduler architecture evolution journey
《DolphinScheduler架构演进之旅》 乔占卫，易观大数据平台技术专家，DolphinScheduler PPMC

item.title: ALC Beijing First Meetup: The Roadblocks on open source Journey?
item.description:
Chinese: “开源到底有多难”

Panel , Guest discussion.

Time: ¶

Aug. 16 14：00 ~ 17：30

Location: ¶

online : bilibili live show (https://live.bilibili.com/22450663)

offline：北京市海淀区丹棱街5号会议室

Agenda : ¶

主持人：潘娟 （准备）

warm welcome：姜宁 (10 min.)

Apache Flink: 李钰 <<Flink中文社区的发展与挑战>> (40 min)

Apache DolphinScheduler：郭炜 <<开源不是天才的甜点，而是勤奋者的盛宴>> (40 min )

Community 演讲主题、时长 内容简介 演讲者
Apache Flink <<Flink中文社区的发展与挑战>> (40 min)
Challenges and development of Apache Flink Community China
  1. Apache Flink 简介
  2. Apache Flink 中文社区从零开始面临的挑战、困难和经验
  3. Apache Flink中文社区取得的成果和发展计划
  1. Brief introduction of Apache Flink
  2. Challenges, difficulties and experience of building a local community from nothing
  3. Achievement and future plan of Apache Flink Community China
 李钰：Apache Flink 社区 PMC 成员, Apache HBase 社区 PMC 成员, ALC-beijing 成员, 阿里巴巴高级技术专家
Yu Li, PMC member of Apache Flink and Apache HBase, member of ALC-beijing, Tech Lead at Alibaba.
Apache DolphinScheduler（Incubating） <<开源不是天才的甜点，而是勤奋者的盛宴>> (40 min )
Open source is not a dessert for genius, but a feast for hardworking people		 开源不是天才的甜点，而是勤奋者的盛宴
1. 开源的初心

3. 优秀开源项目的特性
